name: frame
title: Frame
author: Aiden Zepp
description: A tinted surface with a header, a raised panel and a footer. Children respond to the frame's own width through the @container/frame container (@sm/frame:, @max-lg/frame:, ...). Ships the two tokens it needs beyond stock shadcn (fill-1 and shadow-2xs, SortUI values) so it works without the SortUI theme.
